startTime.description: First transmit epoch to process (inclusive), as an ISO date or timestamp. A naive timestamp is read in the `utcOffsetHours` civil time; null means no lower bound.

endTime.description: Transmit epoch at which processing stops (exclusive), in the same form as `startTime`. Null means no upper bound.

utcOffsetHours.description: Fixed civil-time offset from UTC in hours (whole minutes, -24 to 24). Applies to naive `startTime`/`endTime` values and to the local-time columns of the output; the model is always evaluated in UTC.

overrideStation.description: Station catalog key used for every normal point instead of the station identity recorded in the file.

overrideReflector.description: Reflector catalog key used for every normal point instead of the reflector identity recorded in the file.

minElevationDeg.description: Minimum vacuum elevation of the uplink and downlink at the station, in degrees. Normal points below it are excluded.

lowElevationPolicy.description: Handling of normal points whose elevation lies below the validity floor of the troposphere model: `rejectClamped` excludes them, `allowFlagged` keeps them with the delay evaluated at the floor and flags them.

showProgress.description: Report progress while normal points are evaluated.

chunksize.description: Number of tasks sent to an MPI worker per message. Larger values reduce messaging overhead; smaller values balance load.

mpi.description: MPI scheduling options, used when the run is started with `--mpi`.

troposphere.description: Tropospheric delay model. Falls back to `models.troposphere`.

relativity.description: Relativistic (Shapiro) delay model. Falls back to `models.relativity`.

stationDisplacement.description: Station displacement models; their displacements are summed. Falls back to `models.stationDisplacement`.

reflectorDisplacement.description: Reflector displacement model. Falls back to `models.reflectorDisplacement`.

rangeBias.description: Deterministic range-bias correction applied to the computed observable. Falls back to `models.rangeBias`.

parametrization.description: Parameter blocks available to the estimation. Each entry is a class declaration such as `{type: reflectorPosition}`.

id.description: Unique identifier of the variance component.

station.description: Station catalog key whose normal points belong to this component.

start.description: First UTC date of the component (inclusive).

endExclusive.description: UTC date at which the component ends (exclusive). Null means open-ended.

wavelengthMinNm.description: Lower laser-wavelength bound of the component (inclusive), in nanometres. Null means no bound.

wavelengthMaxExclusiveNm.description: Upper laser-wavelength bound of the component (exclusive), in nanometres. Null means no bound.

varianceComponents.description: Observation groups that each receive their own sigma factor. Every retained normal point must match exactly one component.

maximumAbsoluteM.description: Rejection limit for the absolute prefit one-way residual, in metres. Null disables the test.

maximumAbsoluteByStationM.description: Per-station replacement of `maximumAbsoluteM`, keyed by station catalog key, in metres. A null value disables the test for that station.

minimumOneWayM.description: Smallest plausible reported one-way sigma, in metres. Normal points reporting a smaller sigma are rejected; retained sigmas are not changed.

minimumFractionOfGroupMedian.description: Reported sigmas below this fraction of the median sigma of their variance component are rejected. The effective limit is the larger of this and `minimumOneWayM`.

reportedSigma.description: Screening limits for the reported normal-point sigma.

parametrizations.description: Parametrization types estimated by the following `estimate` steps, replacing the previous selection.

name.description: Unique name of the estimate step; it labels the step in reports.

maxIterationCount.description: Maximum number of linearization iterations of the nonlinear adjustment.

convergenceThreshold.description: The step converges when the largest update of every parameter block is at most this value, in the block's unit (metres for positions and biases, using the 3-D norm per reflector or station).

convergenceThresholdByParametrizations.description: Per-block replacement of `convergenceThreshold`, keyed by parametrization type, in the block's unit.

computeResiduals.description: Evaluate postfit residuals after the step. Required by variance-factor and robust-weight estimation.

estimateVarianceFactors.description: Estimate the variance parameters of every variance component (see `varianceModel`). At every linearization the solution, the variance parameters (divided by the Gaussian consistency factor of the robust weight function) and the robust weights are iterated to their fixed point.

estimateRobustWeights.description: Estimate per-observation weight factors with the `robustWeighting` function, from residuals standardized by their variance under the current weights.

model.description: Robust weighting function: `igg3` (full weight below `k0`, down-weighted between `k0` and `k1`, zero above `k1`) or `directRejection` (zero weight above `k0`).

k0.description: Lower threshold of the robust weighting function, in units of the standardized residual.

k1.description: Upper threshold of `igg3`, in units of the standardized residual; must exceed `k0` (6 if omitted). Not used by `directRejection`.

sessionCorrelation.description: Model one random offset per night session of each variance component (correlated normal points of one night) and estimate its sigma per component.

sessionMaximumGapHours.description: Largest gap between consecutive normal points of one session, in hours.

sessionInitialSigmaM.description: Starting sigma of the session offsets, in metres.

varianceModel.description: Variance function of each variance component. `scaled`: sigma = s * reported sigma. `floorAndScaled`: sigma^2 = a^2 + (s * reported sigma)^2, an error floor `a` added in quadrature, with `a` and `s` estimated by least-squares variance component estimation. A `scaled` estimate drops floors of earlier estimates.

earthOrientationCorrection.description: Estimate corrections of UT1 and the polar motion per station night (normal points of one station without a gap longer than `sessionMaximumGapHours`) as random effects, with the uncertainties of `inputFileEarthOrientationUncertainty` as prior sigmas. Requires the station position partials (a `stationPosition` parametrization). One station night determines only UT0 and the variation of latitude, so the corrections are reported as those two.

earthOrientationSigmaScale.description: Factor applied to the tabulated Earth-orientation uncertainties.

outputFile.description: Output observation-result file with the final postfit residuals.

outputLevel.description: Column set of the residual file: `standard` or `full`.

outputFile.description: Output directory for the final normal equations.

outputFileReport.description: Output processing report: convergence, statistics and publication quality.

outputFileState.description: Output processing state for continuing the run with inputFileProcessingState.

outputFileSolution.description: Output parameter vector with final values and formal uncertainties.

outputFileCovariance.description: Output directory with the parameter covariance matrix.

outputFileReflectorCatalog.description: Output reflector catalog updated with the estimated positions.

outputFileStationCatalog.description: Output station catalog updated with the estimated positions.

processingSteps.description: Ordered processing plan: one leading `screenObservations`, any `selectParametrizations` and `estimate` steps, then one or more output steps.

parameters.description: Patterns (`fnmatch`) of the constrained parameter names `object:type:temporal:interval`, e.g. `*:rangeBias*` or `APOLLO:position.*`.

sigma.description: A-priori sigma, in the unit of the parameters.

stations.description: Datum stations (at least three). Defaults to every station whose position is estimated.

conditions.description: Helmert parameters of the datum stations constrained to zero: `translation` (no-net-translation), `rotation` (no-net-rotation) and `scale`.

sigmaM.description: Sigma of each constrained Helmert parameter, in metres; rotations and scale are expressed as displacements at the Earth's equatorial radius.

constraints.description: Parameter constraints, added as weighted pseudo-observations to every estimate that has their parameters: `aprioriSigma` ties parameters to their a-priori values, `minimalConstraints` defines the station datum by minimum constraints to the a-priori coordinates (instead of fixed stations).

inputFileMassCatalog.description: Native mass catalog with the GM of the Earth, the Moon and the perturbers.

outputFileOrbit.description: Output binary table of the propagated Moon-relative state and its difference to the ephemeris.

outputFileAccelerationDiagnostics.description: Output binary table of the Moon acceleration split by force group.

outputFileMetadata.description: Output metadata: resolved configuration, sources, checksums and statistics.

outputFileRotation.description: Output binary table of the integrated rotation. Required with `lunarRotation`.

ephemerides.description: Ephemeris that supplies the prescribed Earth-Moon barycentre and external-body states, the initial Earth-Moon state and, for a rigid prescribed Moon, the lunar attitude.

initialTdbJd1.description: First part of the TDB Julian date of the initial epoch.

initialTdbJd2.description: Second part of the TDB Julian date of the initial epoch.

durationSeconds.description: Propagation span, in seconds; negative values propagate backwards. Must be a whole multiple of `stepSeconds`.

outputStepSeconds.description: Sampling interval of the orbit and rotation output tables, in seconds.

accelerationDiagnosticsStepSeconds.description: Sampling interval of the acceleration diagnostics, in seconds; a whole multiple of `stepSeconds`. Null writes no diagnostic rows.

j2Undistorted.description: Undistorted lunar J2 (unnormalized), before tidal and rotational deformation.

beta.description: Lunar moment-of-inertia ratio beta = (C - A) / B.

gamma.description: Lunar moment-of-inertia ratio gamma = (B - A) / C; must be less than `beta`.

loveK2.description: Lunar degree-2 potential Love number k2.

tidalDelayDays.description: Time delay of the lunar tidal and rotational response, in days.

radiusM.description: Reference radius of the lunar gravity field, in metres.

meanMotionRadS.description: Lunar orbital mean motion used in the rotational deformation, in rad/s.

includeTidalDeformation.description: Include the deformation raised by the Earth and Sun tides.

includeRotationalDeformation.description: Include the deformation caused by the lunar spin.

c21Static.description: Static unnormalized C21 added to the deformed degree-2 field.

s21Static.description: Static unnormalized S21 added to the deformed degree-2 field.

s22Static.description: Static unnormalized S22 added to the deformed degree-2 field.

anyOf.description: Delayed degree-2 gravity using prescribed lunar attitude; separate from integrated-rotation deformation.

lunarDegree2Gravity.description: Time-variable lunar degree-2 field under the ephemeris attitude. Requires a Moon gravity field; not combinable with `lunarRotation`.

inertiaMoments.description: Principal moments of inertia (A, B, C) of the undistorted Moon, normalized by M R^2 with R = `radiusM`.

radiusM.description: Reference radius used to normalize the moments of inertia, in metres. Must equal the Moon field radius.

initialQuaternion.description: Initial mantle attitude as a unit Hamilton quaternion (scalar first) rotating PA axes to inertial axes.

initialAngularVelocityRadS.description: Initial mantle angular velocity in PA-frame components, in rad/s.

initialCoreAngularVelocityRadS.description: Initial fluid-core angular velocity in mantle PA-frame components, in rad/s. Required exactly when `core` is set.

sources.description: Bodies whose gravity exerts a torque on the lunar figure, by mass-catalog body ID. Each must be in the selected bodies.

gravityTorque.description: Torque model for the `sources`: `quadrupole` uses the inertia tensor, `figure` the full Moon gravity field.

earthFigureTorque.description: Add the torque from the Earth J2 acting on the lunar figure. Requires an Earth gravity field.

geodeticPrecession.description: Include the relativistic geodetic precession in the transport of angular momentum.

polarMomentFraction.description: Polar moment of inertia of the fluid core as a fraction of the total polar moment C.

flattening.description: Geometric flattening of the core-mantle boundary.

viscosityPerS.description: Viscous core-mantle coupling coefficient k_v / C_c, in 1/s. Zero disables viscous coupling.

core.description: Fluid-core model. Null integrates a rigid mantle without a core.

loveK2.description: Lunar degree-2 potential Love number k2.

delayDays.description: Time delay of the lunar deformation response, in days. Must not be shorter than `stepSeconds`.

meanMotionRadS.description: Lunar orbital mean motion used in the rotational deformation, in rad/s.

seedDurationSeconds.description: Length of the seed history integrated backwards before the start epoch to supply delayed states, in seconds. Must cover `delayDays`.

seedModel.description: How the seed history is produced: `rigidBackward` integrates the rigid Moon backwards from the initial state.

includeTidal.description: Include the deformation raised by the external bodies' tides.

includeRotational.description: Include the deformation caused by the lunar spin.

c21Static.description: Static unnormalized C21 added to the deformed degree-2 field.

s21Static.description: Static unnormalized S21 added to the deformed degree-2 field.

s22Static.description: Static unnormalized S22 added to the deformed degree-2 field.

deformation.description: Delayed tidal and rotational deformation of the integrated Moon. Null keeps the figure rigid.

lunarRotation.description: Integrate the mantle (and optional core) rotation together with the orbit. Requires `outputFileRotation`.

maxDegree.description: Highest degree loaded from the file. Defaults to the full field.

radiusM.description: Reference radius of the field, in metres. Defaults to the radius in the file header.

name.description: Label of the field in metadata. Defaults to the body name.

allowMissingCoefficients.description: Accept a file that omits some (degree, order) pairs up to `maxDegree`; the missing coefficients are zero and are listed in the metadata.

earth.description: Static Earth gravity field, evaluated in the Earth-fixed axes selected by `earthPoleModel`.

maxDegree.description: Highest degree loaded from the file. Defaults to the full field.

radiusM.description: Reference radius of the field, in metres. Defaults to the radius in the file header.

name.description: Label of the field in metadata. Defaults to the body name.

allowMissingCoefficients.description: Accept a file that omits some (degree, order) pairs up to `maxDegree`; the missing coefficients are zero and are listed in the metadata.

moon.description: Static Moon gravity field, evaluated in the lunar principal-axis frame.

gravityFields.description: Static spherical-harmonic fields of the Earth and the Moon. At least one must be given.

moonFigurePartners.description: Point-mass bodies that interact with the Moon gravity field, by mass-catalog body ID. Null uses EARTH and the default planets.

earthFigurePartners.description: Point-mass bodies that interact with the Earth gravity field, by mass-catalog body ID. The Moon takes the field acceleration directly and the Earth the reaction of every partner. Null mirrors `moonFigurePartners` with MOON in place of EARTH.

earthDynamicsFrame.description: Earth-orientation model of the gravity axes when `earthPoleModel` is `ephemeris`: `de440` or `de430`.

externalBodyGroups.description: Mass-catalog groups whose bodies act as prescribed perturbers.

earthPoleModel.description: Earth-orientation model of the Earth gravity field axes: `ephemeris` (use `earthDynamicsFrame`), `de430`, `de440` or `iau2006_2000a`.

externalBodyIds.description: Additional mass-catalog body IDs that act as prescribed perturbers.

tideRaisers.description: Bodies that raise tides on the Earth, by mass-catalog body ID.

k20.description: Earth degree-2, order-0 potential Love number.

k21.description: Earth degree-2, order-1 potential Love number.

k22.description: Earth degree-2, order-2 potential Love number.

tauOrbDays.description: Orbital time delays of the order-0, order-1 and order-2 tides, in days.

tauRotDays.description: Rotational time delays of the order-0, order-1 and order-2 tides, in days.

earthRotationRateRadS.description: Earth rotation rate used in the tidal delay, in rad/s.

earthRadiusM.description: Earth reference radius of the tidal potential, in metres.

earthTide.description: Delayed Earth tides raised by `tideRaisers`, acting on the Moon. Null disables the tide.

bodyForceTerms.description: Force terms applied to the Moon, from `point_mass`, `eih_1pn`, `solar_j2`, `figure_earth`, `figure_moon`, `tide`, `lense_thirring` and `solar_radiation_pressure`. Defaults to every configured term; `eih_1pn` requires `point_mass`.

solarJ2.description: Solar J2 (unnormalized), applied about the IAU solar pole. Omit to disable.

fractionalRatePerYear.description: Fractional rate of the solar GM, (dGM/dt)/GM, per Julian year.

referenceJdTdb.description: Epoch at which the solar GM equals its catalog value, as a TDB Julian date.

solarGmVariation.description: Linear drift of the solar GM. Null keeps it constant.

pointGmM3S2.description: GM of each ring point, in m^3/s^2.

obliquityArcsec.description: Inclination of the ring plane to the ICRF equator (the ecliptic obliquity), in arcseconds.

referenceJdTdb.description: Epoch at which the ring phase is `phaseDegrees`, as a TDB Julian date.

phaseDegrees.description: Longitude of the first ring point at `referenceJdTdb`, in degrees.

kuiperBeltRing.description: Ring of equal point masses in circular heliocentric orbits that represents the Kuiper belt. Null disables it.

linearPerYear.description: Linear rate of the Earth J2, per Julian year.

quadraticPerYear2.description: Quadratic coefficient of the Earth J2 polynomial, per Julian year squared (multiplies T^2 directly).

referenceJdTdb.description: Reference epoch of the Earth J2 polynomial, as a TDB Julian date.

earthJ2TimeVariation.description: Polynomial time variation of the Earth J2: J2(t) = J2 + linearPerYear*T + quadraticPerYear2*T^2, with T in Julian years from `referenceJdTdb`.

includeLenseThirring.description: Include the Lense-Thirring acceleration from the solar spin.

includeRadiationPressure.description: Include solar radiation pressure on the Moon.

solarRelativistic.description: Solar Lense-Thirring and radiation-pressure accelerations. Null disables both.

solarRadiusM.description: Solar reference radius for the J2 field and the radiation model, in metres.

stepSeconds.description: Fixed step of the Adams-Bashforth-Moulton integrator, in seconds.

integratorOrder.description: Order of the Adams-Bashforth-Moulton integrator (2 to 13).

correctorIterations.description: Number of corrector passes per step; 2 gives a PECEC scheme.

historyInterpolationOrder.description: Order of the local interpolation of the accepted history for delayed-state queries.

trajectoryInterpolationOrder.description: Order of the local interpolation between integration nodes for the output.

startupStepSeconds.description: Step of the Dormand-Prince (DOP853) start-up integration that produces the first nodes, in seconds.

expectedGroupCounts.description: Expected number of bodies per group; the run fails on any mismatch.

gmbAu3Day2.description: GM of the Earth-Moon system, in au^3/day^2.

earthMoonCanonical.description: Derive the Earth and Moon GM from the Earth-Moon system GM and the mass ratio, so all models share one consistent pair.

bodyId.description: Canonical body ID with NAIF semantics, such as `SUN`, `MARS BARYCENTER` or `NAIF:2000001`.

ephemerisTarget.description: NAIF integer ID used to query the body state from the ephemeris.

gm.description: Gravitational parameter in `gmUnit`. Omitted for EARTH and MOON when `earthMoonCanonical` is given.

groups.description: Group names used to select the body as a perturber, for example `de440_major` or `sb441_asteroid`.

source.description: Provenance of the value, stored in the catalog.

outputFileImportReport.description: Output report with source checksums, record counts and rejected lines.

datasetName.description: Name stored in the header of the output file.

crdUncertaintyPolicy.description: Source of the two-way uncertainty of CRD normal points: `binRmsAsSigma` uses the bin RMS of record 11, `fixed` uses `crdUncertaintyTwoWayS`. Required for CRD input.

crdUncertaintyTwoWayS.description: Two-way uncertainty assigned to every CRD normal point under the `fixed` policy, in seconds.

crdMeteorologyMaxAgeSeconds.description: Largest allowed time between a CRD normal point and the nearest meteorological record, in seconds.

miniTemperatureUnit.description: Unit of the MINI temperature field: `deciCelsius` (0.1 °C) or `deciKelvin` (0.1 K).

oneOf.description: Import CRD, MINI, or native normal points into one canonical file.

variable.description: Name of the loop variable, usable as `{name}` in the program entry.

values.description: Values taken by the loop variable; the program entry runs once per value.

anyOf.description: Expand one program entry over a list of loop values.

loop.description: Run this program entry once per loop value.

when.description: Data-only condition evaluated after loop-variable substitution.

inputFileReflectorCoordinates.description: YAML coordinate source with a `reflectorCoordinates` list. Give either this or the inline `reflectorCoordinates`.

xyzM.description: Reflector position (X, Y, Z) in the lunar principal-axis (PA) frame of the selected ephemeris, in metres.

items.description: One reflector position in the selected ephemeris Moon PA frame.

oneOf.description: Create a native Moon-PA reflector catalog from a source file or inline XYZ.

values.description: Values taken by the loop variable; the program entry runs once per value.

anyOf.description: Expand one program entry over a list of loop values.

loop.description: Run this program entry once per loop value.

when.description: Data-only condition evaluated after loop-variable substitution.

inputFileStationCoordinates.description: YAML coordinate source with a `stationCoordinates` list. Give either this or the inline `stationCoordinates`.

xyzM.description: ITRF Cartesian position (X, Y, Z) at `positionEpochUtc`, in metres. Give either this or the three geodetic fields.

longitudeDeg.description: WGS84 geodetic longitude, east positive, in degrees.

latitudeDeg.description: WGS84 geodetic latitude, north positive, in degrees.

velocityMPerYear.description: ITRF linear velocity (X, Y, Z), in metres per year.

positionEpochUtc.description: UTC reference epoch of the position, as an ISO timestamp.

items.description: One station position given as ITRF XYZ or WGS84 geodetic longitude, latitude, and ellipsoidal height, with an optional linear velocity model.

oneOf.description: Create a native ITRF station catalog from XYZ or WGS84 geodetic coordinates.

file.description: Native EOP file, usually the merged C04/Bulletin-A product.

allowPredicted.description: Use rows whose quality is `prediction`. If false, prediction rows are dropped and a file with `unspecified` quality is rejected.

directory.description: Directory with the SPICE kernels: at least one `.bsp` position kernel and one `.bpc` lunar-orientation kernel.

lunarRelativisticScaleConvention.description: Coordinate scale of the lunar positions in the kernel: `tdbCompatibleLunarSurface` applies the lunar-surface scale difference L_B - L_L when forming LCRS coordinates, `alreadyScaled` applies none.

longitudeLibrationCorrection.description: Periodic correction added to the kernel's longitude libration: `none` or `inpop21a` (three periodic terms for INPOP21a kernels).

name.description: Unique term name; it forms the parameter names.

axis.description: Rotation axis of the term: `x`, `y`, `psi` (PA axes), or `rho`, `Isigma`, `tau` (physical librations referred to the J2000 mean ecliptic).

delaunay.description: Integer multipliers of the Delaunay arguments `l`, `lp`, `F`, `D`, `Om` that form the argument. Give either this or `periodDays`.

periodDays.description: Period of the argument, in days, counted from JD 2451545.0 of the UTC transmit epoch. Give either this or `delaunay`.

estimate.description: Estimate the term. If false, the a-priori amplitudes are applied and kept fixed.

estimateSin.description: Estimate the sine amplitude as well as the cosine amplitude.

reflectors.description: Reflector catalog keys to estimate. Defaults to every observed reflector in the catalog.

stations.description: Station catalog keys to estimate. Defaults to every observed station in the catalog.

fixedStations.description: Station keys held at their catalog positions.

estimateVelocity.description: Also estimate the linear ITRF velocity of each station.

stations.description: Station catalog keys with a bias parameter. Defaults to every observed station.

per.description: `station` estimates one bias per station; `station+interval` one bias per configured interval.

start.description: First UTC date of the bias interval (inclusive).

endExclusive.description: UTC date at which the interval ends (exclusive). Null means open-ended.

name.description: Label of the interval; it forms the parameter name.

file.description: YAML range-bias table (`.yml`/`.yaml`) with `biases` rows. Only for `type: table`.

source.description: Provenance of the inline table. Only for `type: table`.

start.description: First UTC date of the correction (inclusive).

end.description: UTC date at which the correction ends (exclusive).

correctionTwoWayCm.description: Correction in centimetres of two-way light distance; it is subtracted from the computed round-trip time. Overlapping rows add up.

biases.description: Inline correction rows. Only for `type: table`; give either this or `file`.

h2.description: Lunar radial displacement Love number h2.

l2.description: Lunar horizontal displacement Love number l2.

moonRadiusM.description: Lunar reference radius of the tidal potential, in metres.

coefficientFile.description: Ocean pole-tide loading coefficient grid (IERS `opoleloadcoefcmcor.txt` format).

model.description: Expected ocean-tide model name, such as `FES2022b`. The run fails if the BLQ header declares a different model.
